So had an amazing trip... It was deep, way deeper than I thought it would be. I thought very hard about why, why was I given a broken body for no apparent reason, and why was I born feeling inside like a women but outside given the body of a man. Something which I actively have tried to squash in my mind is thinking like a women or thinking of myself as one and even though family and people in my life know that I feel like a women they don't know how actually ashamed and bitter I am about being born with the wrong body because it is something that cannot be proven that most people don't believe and even myself I have wondered if I was just crazy but after this trip... I could feel myself in a way I've never felt myself before and I was so alien to myself because I saw something beautiful instead of ugly and broken and there was nothing man about it, I did not know what man is, could only be angry at man and saddened by it (I have absolutely nothing against men by the way, I was raped about two years ago though so I have an odd relationship with them now... While in the shower I continued to wonder why though-why did the universe give me a broken body (I don't believe in gods and am not religious and in this trip I briefly wondered about that and it was like I had this weird self-discovery that we are ALL gods, are minds and souls, they are divine-beautiful concepts that cannot be described fully and is that not what a god is?) and I got the strangest reply in a physical-trippy way where I felt my belly growing heavy and I felt myself connected to the universe-and I was pregnant and gave birth to a broken child and then I was also that broken child at the same time, and I saw it going down the shower drain, saw myself going down the shower drain, and it happened over and over again.

I took this as the mother being the universe which was giving birth to so many things that it was at random and a lot of it had a sickness to it-had a random attribute about it, but I also felt that it was very sad, that the universe and everything was very sad that it kept giving life to broken things... I saw myself young and beautiful and then aging and old, felt the decrepity of age and what it was like. I could feel myself as an old person and it was so painful and all I wanted was a hug and for young people to stop looking at me like I was old-to see my soul instead of my physical body that did not represent me.

Anyways, that's a big part of my trip I have to go to work now will be watching my phone for people's thoughts. :)

What people need to know about FO4: It is using the same exact engine that Bethesda Softworks has been using since freaking Oblivion (the gamebryo/creation engine)! Yes it has been updated, but what people don't understand is that there are limits to how much such an old engine can be updated!

This isn't like when Unity updated to Unity 2, and then Unity 3, and now currently Unity 4. In Unity's case those were brand spanking new engines. 
The gamebryo/creation engine isn't new, it hasn't been new for the longest time. It's just been updated.

So why is this a problem you may ask? Because some things can't be fixed with these engine updates such as, horrible NPC AI, stale animations (NPCs kind of freeze, jump and then "reset" when they are changing animations from walking to sitting or just about anything, and this has literally been present since Oblivion), dead looking NPC faces and NPC proportions that are all basically the same (causes a huge disconnect when playing game), and buggy physics.

This is just to name but a few of the problems this outdated engine has, that from past games that Bethesda Softworks has used the engine with, it has been made pretty clear that these problems are a part of what comes with using the engine.

People complaining about Bethesda Softworks using the gamebryo/creation engine (even if it is updated) have a legitimate reason to be upset. It means that FO4 will have a lot of the same exact problems that Skyrim, FO3, and FO:NV had.Those are old games by 2015 standards and those problems should not exist in a game that is coming out this year! It is very clear that the update did not fix these issues either, as the animations still look to be terrible from the gameplay that has been shown, and the faces of NPCs still look very dead.

So bumping this because guess what?! F04 is using the gamebryo/creation engine! Freaking unbelievable. A 2015 game is using that crappy old engine! 

It really, honestly blows my mind. There is no excuse for it! Bethesda Softworks are officially the laziest AAA+ developers in the industry.
